content:
raj_sales: ACME vendor risk came back with three hard asks: an EU-only dataflow diagram, a CSV of subprocessors indicating which touch PII, and a one-paragraph CAIQ-friendly answer about encryption/segmentation. Need by tomorrow AM.

ida_presales: Got it. I can create a one-page DFD PNG and the CSV. Quick Q: do they require Private (on-prem) or is Dedicated (EU pinned) acceptable?

raj_sales: They prefer Dedicated pinned to EU; Hosted only if we can guarantee no cross-border backups and disable region fallback.

sam_security: Notes to include in pack: KMS options (customer-managed KMS in EU or Redwood HSM with split-escrow only if contracted), KV cache persistence behavior (ephemeral on Hosted, persistent in EU for Dedicated/Private), and telemetry rules (pseudonymize then store EU-only).

ida_presales: Draft routing snippet to paste into questionnaire:
```yaml
deployment:
  mode: hosted
  regions_allowed: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
  allow_fallback: false
storage:
  backups.cross_region: false
  backups.retention_region: eu-central-1
cache:
  persistent: false
```

mona_legal: When you post the subprocessors CSV include a sample notification clause for the DPA: "Redwood will notify Customer 30 days before engaging any new subprocessor that may process Customer Data; Customer may reasonably object." I'll prepare DPA language if they push.

ida_presales: CSV preview rows I'll include: Google Cloud (compute/storage)	infra	PII/encrypted blobs	EU zones only; Datadog	monitoring	metrics (pseudonymized)	EU tenant; Sentry	errors	traces (PII scrubbed)	EU hosts; Zendesk	support	ticket metadata	EU residency enabled; HashiCorp/Customer KMS	keys	key material	customer/EU.

sam_security: Add: backups containing PII are disabled in this configuration; audit logs can be stored in EU-only buckets; KMS rotation recommended every 90 days; key access logged and restricted.

raj_sales: Also need a short pricing note for 50 RPS: Hosted (EU-pin) baseline estimate, Dedicated EU-only ~ +40% vs Hosted, Private on-prem requires SOW. A rough monthly delta is fine.

ida_presales: Will bundle: DFD PNG, subprocessors CSV, CAIQ blurb, pricing note, and legal clause sample. Uploading artefacts here when ready. ETA ~5 hours.

redwood-bot: asset uploaded: /internal/security/dfd/1778880011-acme-eu-dfd.png (sha256:bb7c9a24d3a1)

raj_sales: Great — once uploaded I'll forward to ACME security and loop legal for evidence requests. Thanks team :thumbsup:
